title: Nik Singhal Quoted in Mergers & Acquisitions Annual Due Diligence Study: AI & Emerging Trends
summary: Nik Singhal, ORIX USA’s Group Head of Direct Lending, recently shared his perspective on the due diligence process for Mergers and Acquisitions&#8217
body_markdown:
[Nik Singhal](https://www.orix.com/people/nik-singhal-orix-usa/) , ORIX USA’s Group Head of Direct Lending, recently shared his perspective on the due diligence process for *Mergers and Acquisitions’* 2nd Annual Due Diligence Study. Nik highlighted how greater access to industry data and competitive benchmarking enables managers to ask more targeted questions, conduct deeper analysis and enhance the quality of due diligence in the years ahead.


Highlights from Nik:


- “Industry, competitive and other relevant benchmarking data will become more readily available. This will allow parties to ask more pointed and relevant questions, which hopefully increases the quality of diligence.”
